_doc: 2026-07-29 QA review (Liv birthday book, 'AI Writer Feedback & Word List'): poetic register that reads as mood, not story, to a young listener. Tier rule: `hard` holds only words with no plausible early-reader use AND a drop-in replacement (so the single surgical gatefix trivially clears them); any word found in real board books stays `soft` (advisory — feeds revision notes, never blocks). Words the review listed but that are dual-use for children (flutter, bob, hum, sway, tangle-as-verb, vanish) were deliberately tiered soft per that rule. Replacements ride the failure message — they are the surgical-fix fuel. `safeRegister` is the review's positive guidance list, printed into the writer prompt. Band routing lives in checks/bannedWords.js (hard for PB_INFANT/PB_TODDLER, everything soft for PB_PRESCHOOL, exempt for PB_EARLY_READER).
